item.title: Less can be more for predicting properties with large language models
item.content:encoded:
Nature Computational Science, Published online: 12 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s43588-026-01045-2

Researchers show that large language models cannot learn from spatial coordinates regardless of model or data scale. Specialized geometric neural networks consistently outperform language models for material property prediction.
